description: Catalog all X-MEM files; names + register counts printed to PRINT buffer
example: XEQ "EMDIR" -> prints file list e.g. PROG1 P 20 / DATA1 D 100
notes: Output goes to print_buffer; drain via PRA/PRX. Empty X-MEM prints nothing.

description: Return number of available X-MEM registers in X
example: XEQ "EMROOM" -> X = 319 (319 registers free in a fresh X-MEM)
notes: Result in X; available capacity decreases by (entry + registers) per stored file.

description: Save current program to X-MEM file named by ALPHA register
example: "MYPROG" ALPHA, XEQ "SAVEP" -> program stored as MYPROG in X-MEM
notes: ALPHA must hold the filename (1-6 chars). Round-trip: SAVEP then GETP restores exact program.

description: Load program from X-MEM file named by ALPHA into current program memory
example: "MYPROG" ALPHA, XEQ "GETP" -> program memory replaced with MYPROG
notes: ALPHA must hold the filename. Existing program memory is overwritten.

description: Save all 100 data registers to X-MEM file named by ALPHA register
example: "REGS" ALPHA, XEQ "SAVED" -> R00-R99 stored in X-MEM file REGS
notes: Saves the full 100-register set. Use GETD to restore. Pairs with GETD for register transfer.

description: Load all data registers from X-MEM file named by ALPHA register
example: "REGS" ALPHA, XEQ "GETD" -> R00-R99 restored from X-MEM file REGS
notes: Loads the full 100-register set from a data file. Existing registers are overwritten.

description: Return number of registers used by X-MEM file named by ALPHA in X
notes: ALPHA must hold an existing filename. Returns register count for that specific file.

description: Save X register value to first register of X-MEM file named by ALPHA
example: 42 ENTER, "VAL" ALPHA, XEQ "SAVERX" -> first register of VAL set to 42
notes: Stores X into the active X-MEM file's register 0. Creates the file if it does not exist.
